107000.description: Starting today, I retire. But what should I do...... I don't have any talents, and I don't have the brains for business. My only talent is to defeat enemies all over the world. What a pain......
synonyms: The Master of Martial Arts Retired Life

title.english: The Top Martial Artist's Retired Life
title.romaji: Wulin Zhi Wang De Tui Yin Shenghuo

107001.description:
After being proposed to, Mio was on cloud nine. Her life as a newlywed was just about to begin... That is, until her soon-to-be husband leaves her for another woman and she falls into the depths of despair. That's when Eita shows up, a friend from her school days who also just happens to be her fiance's younger brother! He tells Mio he's there for her, then pushes her down onto the bed... Eita teases her with his fingers and tongue, sweetly whispering into her ear, asking if she wants him to stop. It tingles... Her heart won't stop racing!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: In the Wake of a Broken Heart -Sleeping with His Younger Brother-
title.native: 俺がトロトロにしてあげる～私を抱くのは彼の弟～
title.romaji: Ore ga Torotoro ni Shite Ageru: Watashi wo Daku no wa Kare no Otouto

title.native: ミエタミエナイセカイ

107003.description:
Jana’s a talented artist, but she’s also an awkward high school girl. When her first love Conrad transfers to her school, she’s over the moon until this popular genius very publicly denies knowing her. Before she dies from the online shaming, the mysterious creature Dolo has just the thing for her — a capsule to change her destiny! All it requires in exchange is something valuable to her. What will Jana sacrifice to make her dreams come true? Nothing could go wrong… right?

(Source: Tapas)

107004.description: Misaki, a manga artist in her late twenties, is turned down by her crush one day. While drinking away her pain she runs into a handsome younger man who seems to have taken an interest her. She knows he's just playing with her, but she can't help but feel excited as he brings his face close to hers. He assuages her moral doubts and insists she yearn for him. She may be getting used by this young stud... But even so, would it be so bad to indulge herself a little?
synonyms: Anta no Iitoko, Zenbu Oshiete? Zetsurin Danshi no Honki Sex

title.english: Tell Me What You Like -Getting with a Guy Equal to None-
title.native: アンタの良いとこ、ぜんぶ教えて？絶倫男子の本気SEX
title.romaji: Anta no Yoitoko, Zenbu Oshiete? Zetsurin Danshi no Honki Sex

107005.description: This is surely a story you've never thought of! The cartoon’s main character is called Yuan Xin. She’s an otaku who likes to immerse herself in a fantasy world. She, who likes to look at hot guys--after embarrassing herself in front of them in the school yard, decides to retaliate. Unexpectedly, during the crucial moment, an accident happened, and she crossed over to the game world!

107006.description: Joo Sungwan is working as a fake ghost in order to pay back for a broken laptop, but instead of scaring customers, Sungwan is the one being scared! Even worse, there’s an actual ghost living in the haunted house?! With his job on the line, Sungwan ends up in a dating contract with the ghost — in exchange for the ghost scaring visitors, Sungwan must give him three wishes and be his boyfriend.
synonyms: Not for the Faint of Heart

107007.description:
1. Jigoku Elevator (地獄エレベーター)
2. Teru Teru Bouzu (てるてる坊主)
3. Yuurei Life (ゆーれいライフ)
4. Sakura no Shoujo-tachi (櫻の少女たち)
5. Jigoku Shoujo "Samayoeru Koigokoro" (地獄少女「さまよえる恋心」)

title.native: 本当にヤバイホラーストーリー
title.romaji: Hontou ni Yabai Horror Story Tomodachi Jigoku

107008.description:
The assassin Yan Po wipes out all 18 members of the Huang family in one blood-drenched night, stealing the secrets to shape-shifting magic in the process, subsequently disappearing without a trace. One girl from the Huang family survived, vowing to take revenge. 70 years later, the most popular phrase in Chang’an is “As the mantis stalks the cicada, behind them will lurk the Golden Sparrow. I shall not rest until Yan Po appears.

(Source: Tapas)

107013.description:
Mameda is a tanuki who was born in the wrong era - all she wants is to trick humans, but that age of tanuki shenanigans is over. But one woman, a rakugo master named Bunko, shows Mameda it's still possible to cast magic on humans...only with words, not illusions. Mameda is determined to become Bunko's apprentice, but can she convince the stoic master to take her on...?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title.native: うちの師匠はしっぽがない
title.romaji: Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai

107014.description:
Ryousuke's art is what makes him special, but it also makes him weird. Bullied at school, he hides his art from others, but in doing so, he ends up hiding his true self. That is, until the day he meets a girl painting under an overpass, and this chance encounter inspires him in ways he is only beginning to understand…

(Source: Mangamo)

title.native: 佐伯さん家のブラックキャット

107016.description:
Class 2–2 is filled with nothing but standout, eccentric students.
Let’s take a brief peek at the hectic days that unfold in their classroom.

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

107017.description:
Have you ever wished someone dead? Maybe that bully who's harassing you at school could use a permanent vacation? If so, just contact the Tranquility Support Center, and they'll put an end to pesky harassers with good, old-fashioned murder! Of course, there is a price to pay, but it's worth it, right…?

(Source: Mangamo)

title.native: 死逢わせサポートセンター

107018.description:
Arika is what you could charitably call a vampire "enthusiast." When she stumbles across the beautiful and mysterious vampire Divo however, her excitement quickly turns to disappointment as she discovers he's not exactly like the seductive, manipulative villains in her stories. His looks win first place, but his head's a space case.

Armed with her extensive knowledge of vampire lore, Ariko downgrades Divo to a beta vampire and begins their long, long... long journey to educate him in the ways of the undead.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Ringo to Bara to Kyuuketsuki (Temporary Title)
The Apple, the Rose, and the Vampire

title.native: 林檎と薔薇と吸血鬼（仮）
生まれ変わらないでいてくれ

107020.description:
Chika and Aya are in love with the same teacher. Determined to be the victor even if it meant using any means necessary, Chika accidentally comes to know Aya's true nature.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: あの鐘を鳴らすのは少なくともおまえじゃない
title.romaji: Ano Kane wo Narasu no wa Sukunakutomo Omae Janai

107021.description:
Joo-ah lives alone after her grandfather died. She was cleaning her grandfather's mansion when she found a mysterious pumpkin stone ring. At that time, Seok-nam, the spirit in the pumpkin stone, appeared and called Joo-ah a priest!

(Source: Lezhin; translated)

_Note: The chapter count contains an epilogue._

107022.description: In the Heian period, there was a princess whose beauty was exquisite enough to attract even the emperor. She was Princess Kaguya. What will become of an orphaned girl named Tsubaki when she founds out the ridiculous secret that the super famous princess was actually a... man who came from the world above?!

title.native: かぐや姫のかくしごと

107023.description:
When a tough, rebellious Eric arrives at a German boarding school, there is one fellow student he hates: Thoma. Thoma bears a striking resemblance to Eric, but is gentle, delicate, and idolized by his classmates.

(Source: Manga! Manga! The World of Japanese Comics)

107024.description:
A man returns from a trip after hearing news about his former love's passing.

(Source: Golden Roze)

107025.description:
The female boss of the beautiful nightclub Lan plays the fool for the sake of getting a divorce appointed husband. During the daytime she is the ugly wife of Chu’an whom he hates and at night she was the most attractive singer. While her plan is proceeding, her husband’s young handsome remote uncle Sir Qin, a warlord, seems to have found her secret just by chance and falls for her gradually when he gets to know her more and more. Where will this relationship go?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Junfa Laogong Zei Huai Hen Hen Bazhan ni

title.native: 军阀老公贼坏：狠狠霸占你
title.romaji: Junfa Laogong Zei Huai: Hen Hen Bazhan Ni

107026.description:
It took her three months to get used to her new identity—Xi's aunt. Every time she watches Xi dates with his new girlfriend, she always feels heartbroken. How could he forget everything? "I was not and am not and will never be your aunt, I am your..." Her mouth is sealed by a kiss before she could finish herwords. "I don't care who you are, I just know that I want to kiss you."
(Source: MangaToon)

107027.description:
Tess, a common high school girl, ran into a genius boy at the nightclub and kissed him accidentally! That kiss reminds him of his disappeared lover... what's the relationship between the nightclub girl and his sweet lover? During the search for the truth, a big conspiracy finally uncovered...

(Source: MangaToon)

107028.description:
She, who was once an ordinary girl, now only wants to cultivate herself and return to the earth as soon as possible. What troubles her most is that her identity is the consort of Fox King in this world. A really clingy one. Wherever she goes, he follows. What is the wrong with his persistence? For love, let's see what can a thousand years fox king do.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 今日から狐王の寵愛受けます
Transmigrated Into the Fox King’s Adored Wife

title.english: Back in Time: The Fox King's Sole Affection
title.romaji: Chuanyue Zhi Hu Wang De Zhuan Chong

107029.description: The next-generation story of Sensual Phrase: Sakuya Ookouchi's new project launches! Sakuya discovers the next-generation hero who will usher in a new era!
synonyms: Sono Koe de, Sono Uta o.

title.romaji: Sono Koe de, Sono Uta wo.

107030.description: A comic-essay about the experiences of an employee for TV Tokyo.

title.native: オンエアできない！女ADまふねこ（23）、テレビ番組つくってます
title.romaji: On Air Dekinai! Onna AD Mafuneko (23), TV Bangumi Tsukuttemasu

107031.description: A comic-essay about the experiences of an employee for TV Tokyo.

107032.description:
A new generation sports manga featuring e-sports! Aoba, a lethargic high school student, became inspired by a FPS game, playing with Chizuru, a gal who loves video games! They will challenge the world of e-sport competitions with the unique personalities on his team!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

title.native: GGWP！ －グッドゲームウェルプレイド！－

107033.description: A comic-essay by KANA about their life after moving to Portland, Oregon, in the summer of 2017.

107035.description:
Kotake Mukouhara Senior High School's soccer team was once the favorite to be the prefectural champions, until ten of their eleven players mysteriously disappeared. Now, only their star forward, Ashida Isami, remains, and his childhood friend Katena Chiyo is in danger of having to marry their rival team's forward if he can score more points than Isami in the championship final!

Note: Published in Young Magazine #6 in 2015, as part of their "Ore no The 100th!!" series, where well-known manga artists attempt to write the 100th chapter of a manga without the other 99

107036.description: A school is transported into a fantasy world that is at war with dragons, and everyone in the school is given a powerful dragon slaying sword, and told the only way to get home is to help win the war. But there is a catch, to use the swords power you must be...a virgin!

title.native: 学園ドラゴンスレイヤー

107037.description: Motokazu has been asked by a physics professor to convince the now-reclusive former child-genius Homizu Saraka to come to class. While he speaks with her, a question comes up that sparks her curiosity: Can humans create a universe? He's able to get her to come to class, but he's also caught up in her brilliant and dangerous plan to see if this is truly possible.

107038.description:
Rie has a violent streak and hates all men after being abandoned by her abusive father, but is saved from attempted sexual assault by her senpai Kousuke. She falls in love and decides to accept an invitation to his house when his parents aren't around.

Note: Published in COMIC KOH Volume 2.

107039.description:
Mother-son incest.

A mother got jealous that her son got so many chocolates on valentine day. She then creates ultimate chocolate for him.

107041.description: Sara is a student in a women-only school and has been raised protected and covered from everything. Until one day she crossed paths with a boy as beautiful as he is dangerous...

title.romaji: Tenshi wa Nido, Uso wo Tsuku

107043.description: A remake of George Akiyama's 1979 manga Gyara.

107045.description: Cheng Yi Nuo was badly framed by her sister. She did not want to give in to fate. She wanted to rely on her intelligence to be an entertainment reporter. She did not expect to shoot on the first mission to her boss?

107046.description:
Badly humiliated by him to pay her father's debts off, she thought she was in hell. She hadn't expected that it was just a beginning and a magnificent revenge. Who on earth was sinking in heart?
(Source: MangaToon)

title.english: The Devil's Game: Training His Sweet Wife
title.romaji: Emo Youxi: Tiaojiao Xiao Tian Qi

107047.description:
Mu Qingge never understood why she and her investor, Dong Fangyan, who spent 70 million to forcibly marry her, don't get along. Why does he pick on her and humiliate her so? With the return of her step-brother Huo Zhangling, the superstar Lu Linghan's kindness to her, and the sudden appearance of the Bai-clan siblings, a past sealed away is slowly being uncovered. What is the secret buried by time? And how will it affect all their lives?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

107048.description:
A sheet of contract and a ransom of ten million changed her into a close maid to an evil-like billionaire. Although once a rich young lady, she was made a puppet nowadays. He tried his best to torture her only to give birth to a boy to revenge against his family? In an attempt to flee away from him, she learnt how to seduce men and contribute her body, swearing to identify who was manipulating her life.
(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: ตื้อหัวใจภรรยาน้อย

107049.description:
Zhu Jinyu is an eighteen-year-old girl who died from overeating and finds herself in the afterlife Her death was a mistake, and to make things right, she was sent to another world as a chubby fairy Reborn as Chichi, she gets to enjoy a new life in a new world where she might possibly find love

(Source: INKR)

107050.description:
Because of a superstition, I was deceived by my beloved to dedicate my wedding night to the King of Yama (king of hell, who masters the life and death people in mortal world), and my parents were sent as sacrifice to the God of River. Although my parents were fine after that, I could not escape from the control of the king of hell...
(Source: WebComics)

107051.description:
How romantic meeting his destined lover in travels! In this story, he picks their shells of memory for her in seaside of Sea of Love, sings for her on the top of minaret in the Flower Citt, and shoots the unique starry night with her. They meet, understand and fall for each other. Miraculous travel ends, their love journey starts. *Note*: Yue in Chinese means moon and Xing stands for stars. That's how the title come from.

(Source: WebComics)

107053.description:
Zhang Nan, the young master of the Hidden Dragon Family, wanted to become an ordinary person, but he was sent to the aristocratic training school by his grandfather. When he was assigned to an all-female class by a confused teacher, Zhang Nan finds himself tortured by these heirs to the brink of dropping out..

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Wo de Fan Pai Nv You

107054.description:
They call her Saintess, a mystical and beautiful holy figure that guides the nation. Suddenly one day, her body has switched with a flippant, crude womanizer! To conceal the emergency, she's sent to hide at a college as a normal student. But how is that possible with a scheme to get rid of her and all these hearts aflutter at school?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

107056.description:
Orphaned at a young age, Alice has lived with her aunt for most of her childhood. But her uncle is abusive and resentful, and at 15 Alice decides to return home to Kyoto and train as a maiko, eventually hoping to become a geisha.

But when she arrives back at her birthplace, she finds that Kyoto has changed quite a bit in the eight years since she left it. Almost as if it's a completely different world...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: ひとっこひとり百鬼の里

synonyms: Gunjou no Ensemble: Ni-nen San-kumi no Seito-tachi
Gunjou no Ensemble: Ninen Sankumi no Seitotachi

title.native: 群青のアンサンブル～2年3組の生徒たち～

107061.description:
Its near the end of the Heian era and Tamamo is a young noblewoman with curly hair something that is seen as ugly and strange. Fallen on hard times after the death of her father and sister because the actions of a cruel nobleman she dreams of revenge. She meets a young man Naoto who is kind and protective towards her. He has amibitions to become an Onmyouji. Due to various circumstances they release an evil fox spirit named Otsuka-sama who promises Nao that she can help her punish the nobles who mistreated her and destroyed her family. All that she requires is her soul.

Can Nao save Tamamo before she is lost to the darkness? The story of “Tamamo-no-mae” and “Nine-tailed fox” begins here!

107063.description: In the second volume is included the one-shot "Okaasan Yubi" (おかあさんゆび), previously published in the yuri anthology "My Sweet Home"

title.native: たえちゃんとじみこさん

107064.description:
Hashimoto the vampire, who up until now has been getting-by by drinking blood (or rather, milk substituting for blood), has, due to a happening upon a gourmet-food manga come to try human food.

Never-before tasted meals of many varieties, prove for a lip-smackingly great time...or rather, SHOULD have - but being a 260 year-old recluse, he isn't exactly familiar with how things work in the human world, I can't see this going smoothly!

title.native: 夢喰いバクと悪夢の子
title.romaji: Yume Kui Baku to Akumu no Ko

107066.description: The psychotic lover Hime fell in love with Kazuki at first sight. Since then, they've been dating for 6 months, but Hime just found out that Kazuki is not a man.

title.native: 晒名読子は見られたい。

107072.description:
Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Sarashina Yomiko wa Miraretai.

title.native: 読んでて恥ずかしくなるラブコメ

107074.description:
1-4. Hinagiku Virgin Lost Club e Youkoso ♡ (ヒナギク・ヴァージン・ロスト・クラブへようこそ♡); Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-08, 2018-09, 2018-10, 2018-11
5-6. Neko Yashiki Yumemi wa Kyou mo Niramu 1/2 (猫屋敷夢美は今日も睨む1／2); Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-06, 2018-07
7-9. Joou-sama wa M no Dorei (女王様はMの奴隷); Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-02, 2018-04, 2018-05
synonyms: Neko Yashiki Yumemi wa Kyou mo Niramu 1/2
Welcome to Hinagiku Virgin Lost Club

title.native: ヒナギクヴァージンロストクラブへようこそ♡
title.romaji: Hinagiku Virgin Lost Club e Youkoso ♡

107077.description:
Kaoru, a high school student, falls in love with Sonoko, the leader of his school's swimming club. Although he can not swim, he joins the swim club to seduce her.

It was adapted into a live action film directed by Joji Matsuoka in 1990.

synonyms: 幻想（まぼろし）の普通少女

107082.description:
1. Gusha no Rakuen (愚者の楽園)
2. Daichi no Kizoku (大地の貴族)
3. Bibou no Kajitsu (美貌の果実)
4. Kakuu no Mori (架空の森)

107083.description: A modern re-tail of The Little Mermaid. Featuring a delusional mermaid, and a whimsy "prince".

107084.description:
"I'm gonna change my life!!" --- Yuuta, who failed at his job hunting, went to local tattoo shop on impulse with such determination. There, he met a blonde guy with piercing, named Atsushi. On their first meeting, Atsushi confessed he fell in love with Yuuta at the first sight!!
Although Atsushi is a good looking man, skilled at sex and seems like a fun person, while embracing Yuuta, he said, "It's fine if Yuu-kun is the only person by my side."
Because of that, they began to live under the same roof. But, Atsushi always keep his eyes on Yuuta 24/7, and that is to show his possessiveness!?

107086.description: It’s a cute story about a girl and her cell phone that is really the latest in technology and can transform into a boy! Also, the way to upgrade it is non-other than doing intimate things such as kissing! Embarrassing moments and rivals appear!

title.native: 非科学常識ケータイくん!

107087.description:
Juyoon Oh is a typical guy trying to find a full-time job. But one day, he dives into the Han River and puts himself at risk of drowning to save a child that fell in. As he is about to meet an untimely death, a goddess appears before him and gives him a chance at another life... not as a hero or a wizard, but as a weak, skill-less "brick larva." It's the beginning of an atrocious adventure, and the road to become a hero is long!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: ダンジョン・マジェスティ
女神、异世界和变成砖头虫的我
No Doubt, Even Better Than Sis...

title.native: きっとお姉ちゃんより…
なんかイイことあった？

title.romaji: Kago no Chuu, Kumo o shitau.

107093.description:
1. Goukaku H! (ごーかくえっち！); Comic Hotmilk 2017-03
2. Danchou Onegaishimasu! (団長お願いします！); Comic Hotmilk 2017-08
3. Kitto Onee-chan Yori... (きっとお姉ちゃんより…, No Doubt, Even Better Than Sis...); Comic Hotmilk 2017-10
4. Nanka Ii Koto Atta? (なんかイイことあった？, Did something good happened?); Comic Hotmilk 2018-03
5. Kago no Chuu, Kumo o shitau. (籠の蟲、蜘蛛を慕う。); Comic Hotmilk 2018-06
synonyms: Kago no Chuu, Kumo o shitau.
No Doubt, Even Better Than Sis...

107095.description:
A young couple having their first time together after coming back from the summer festival.

Note: Published in Comic Hotmilk 2019-01

107096.description:
"A harem in another world!?" University student Shiki Satou woke up in another world's dungeon town. There he discovered Healing Magic, but as he did nothing but sexual harassment in exchange for healing others... he finally got fired from the clinic he worked at. He was at a loss, but decides to explore the dungeon as an adventurer to earn a living. That's when he encounters Yuel, a young maimed slave girl...

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: I Work as a Healer in Another World Labyrinth City

title.english: The Healing Wizard in Another World
title.native: 異世界の迷宮都市で治癒魔法使いやってます
title.romaji: Isekai no Meikyuu Toshi de Chiyu Mahoutsukai Yattemasu

107097.description: Shizuku Hayama is the personal bodyguard for Ichika Kiryuin, the only daughter of a major industrialist. But Ichika is no shrinking violet, and she's perfectly able to handle any dangerous situation or challenge by herself. If Ichika doesn't need anyone protect her body, maybe Shizuku can help to protect her heart?
synonyms: My Lady Won't Let me Protect Her

title.native: お嬢様が護らせてくれない

107098.description:
The story begins when the gods call a conference to decide the whether to let humanity live or die, and settle on destroying humanity. But a lone valkyrie puts forward a suggestion to let the gods and humanity fight one last battle, as a last hope for humanity's continued survival. 13 gods will fight against 13 human champions in one-on-one battles to decide whether humanity lives or dies.

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: มหาศึกคนชนเทพ

107099.description:
The high school columnist looking for the next big story gets more than she bargained for when she digs into the wife of a man she meets. The female anime characters that the class nerd draws become real and over protective of their creator. The monster behind the old child’s story haunts the people that break the rules of the contract. These are some of the episodes in this collection of short horror stories.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

107100.description:
Flum Apricot was never meant to be a hero. Despite zero stats across the board and a power she can’t even use, she somehow finds herself included in a party of heroes. But Flum’s life hits rock bottom when the party’s renowned sage, Jean Inteige, decides that the useless girl is dead weight, and arranges to have her sold into slavery. Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master’s entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon…and something new awakens within her. A grimdark tale about one woman’s blood-soaked quest to reclaim her life!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Do You Think Someone like You Could Defeat the Demon Lord?
「就凭你也想打败魔王吗」被勇者一行所驱逐的少女要如何才能在王都过上自由的生活
Bị đuổi khỏi nhóm Anh hùng, tôi muốn sống tự do tự tại ở Vương đô

title.english: ROLL OVER AND DIE: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
title.native: 「お前ごときが魔王に勝てると思うな」と勇者パーティを追放されたので、王都で気ままに暮らしたい
title.romaji: "Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omou na" to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai

107101.description:
"It's so obvious that we can listen music for free, but all music losing its value. ─"

The near future. Drinking into the wave of progressive data conversion and flattening, digital music has been losing value, On the other hand, "live artists" expressing realistic music were reevaluated and became the admiration of many people.

Revolution to Live, Known as "LiveRevolt". In such a world, Girls struggle to win peaks at the live artist training school "Kanadegaoka Girls School". This is a story of the girls who aimed at the top of the live artists and fought with songs as the sword.

107102.description:
Takeru and Seiichirou are childhood friends. They grew apart over the years but have recently been meeting each other again. Takeru enjoys hanging out with Seiichirou just like when they were kids, but he learns that the same person has become infamous for being a huge playboy. He's perplexed, but more so when Seiichirou kissed and confessed to him while drunk.

(Source: nan-chatte)

107104.description:
This is the tale of a protagonist who was summoned to protect the demon king from the hero.

Kuroki was suddenly summoned to another world. The one who summoned him was the demon king, Modes. And, the territory currently ruled by the demon king was on the verge of destruction because of the hero.

The demon king Modes, possessing an atrocious appearance, bows toward Kuroki.

「PLEASE SAVE US, SAVIOR-DONO！！」

Kuroki then decides to save the demon king due to some turn of events.

title.native: 暗黒騎士物語 勇者を倒すために魔王に召喚されました
title.romaji: Ankoku Kishi Monogatari: Yuusha wo Taosu Tameni Maou ni Shoukansaremashita

107105.description:
Turbulent times are coming to an end, but women must continue fighting. Ran Hattori fled her wedding to live as a shinobi rather than as a wife. Meanwhile, Takechiyo, who will be known as Iemitsu Tokugawa, is shunned by his mother, and someone is plotting to assassinate him. Within Edo Castle, amid a fierce battle for succession, the two—never meant to meet—begin to develop feelings that go beyond those of master and servant.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

107106.description: While the family business bankrupted overnight and her boyfriend cheated at the same time, anger made her reach for the bottle. Hopelessly drunk, she forced someone she just met less than 3 days ago to marry her! Luckily, he is not so bad-looking and very nice - but he lied about his identity! He claimed that he was an assistant, but who knew that he was actually a billionaire! (Source: WebComics)

107107.description:
There is a dead body town (Graveyard) where all corpses from around the world gather. On the outskirts of the city there is a stranger's dead body, the scholar Karon, and a laboratory with the motto of ghastly grave protection. A woman brings a tearing brother's dead body to the corpse street... and so a dark fantasy tale over the secret of a strange corpse begins.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)
synonyms: A Crooked Man in the Graveyard

title.native: グレイヴヤードの捩じくれた家

2. Manatsu no Bourei Chicken Race (真夏の亡霊チキンレース)

Bonus Track. Co-op Tanaka no Manatsubi - (コーポ田中の真夏日)

(Source: natalie.mu)

107109.description: Small stories set in a small town.

107111.description:
It's August 15th, the season of the Bon Festival. Aki likes this time of year because she can see the spirits of everyone's ancestors that come back home, and wishes that it could stay like this forever. However, her wish comes true as the same day begins to repeat over and over. She works together with a mysterious young man named Natsuo, the only other person in town who notices the days repeating, in order to find out what's going on, and how to return things back to normal.

(Source: Leed Publishing, translated)

107112.description:
Saint Cecilia is beloved by the townspeople—not only is she elegant and composed, she benevolently shares her wisdom with all who seek it. That is, until the last person has left—at which point she becomes totally hopeless! Only Pastor Lawrence, is keeping the Saint put together enough to do her duties...and though she may test him, it's all in a day's work!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: The White Holy Woman and the Black Priest
รักใสใสหัวใจข้ามรุ่น

title.native: しょうもない僕らの恋愛論

107114.description:
A cosmic disaster changed the Earth forever, stripping away every last drop of color from the world. Mankind also changed: the familiar human face is almost forgotten in a world now populated wholly by mutants. Against the backdrop of a moody urban landscape, a lone wolf investigator named Avidia relies on both his wits and extraordinary gun to hunt down the world’s last hidden scraps of color. He soon crosses paths with a very special girl–one who just might hold the key to bringing back what the world has lost.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

107115.description: A manga editor at a publisher is truck'd into a new world and works as a publisher in his new world.

title.native: 異世界出版の編集さん

107116.description:
In the not-so-distant future, Japan continues to make extraordinary discoveries and advancements, including the ability to print your own companion! With a bio-printer, anyone can have the critter of their dreams. Well, assuming it prints correctly, that is. Unfortunately for Sato, while trying to print a Shiba Inu, an error results in a totally different creature—one that has never been seen before! Sato has no idea what he’s created or how to care for it, but despite the oddities, he’s endeared by the squishy and soft cutie. Even his friend is charmed by the odd, loaf-shaped pet and gives it the perfect name: Mochimochi!

But when Sato learns that there are others like Mochi, their social circle begins to grow–leaving them with more questions about this peculiar printed pal.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Thirteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category

title.native: プリンタニア・ニッポン
